newsitem.title: FRANCE: Full-freighter aircraft share of Paris Jan 97 air.
newsitem.headline: Full-freighter aircraft share of Paris Jan 97 air.

text.p: Full-freighters share of global air cargo traffic handled at the Paris airports in January 1997 was down 0.7 percentage points on Jan '96, Aeroports de Paris (ADP). figures show.
Full-freighters had a 37.7 percent share of the ADP's Jan global air cargo throughput (imports and exports) totalling 81,927 tonnes, compared to 38.4 percent a year earlier.

Volume of airfreight handled at CDG and Orly airports transported by full-freighter aircraft in January was down 0.4 percent on January 1996 at 30,919 tonnes. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
